title: Massage Seat and Seat-Related Options
summary: Feedback centers on requests for massage seats and other seat-related options, with many examples phrased as wishes or availability gaps rather than clearly labeled sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the idea of having more optional features, including massage seats and other selectable configurations.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly describe desired but unavailable massage seats or other options without enough explicit sentiment labeling to classify them more specifically.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are classified as undetermined, which limits clear interpretation of customer sentiment.
This cluster mixes massage-seat requests with unrelated option topics such as sunroof, suspension, subscriptions, PDF download, seat-belt styling, and backrest adjustment.
Examples are insufficient to separate opinions about seat comfort from opinions about option availability with confidence.
